children: European stocks moved higher on Tuesday, with both the STOXX 50 and STOXX 600 rising 0.7%, extending gains from the previous two sessions and marking their first three-day winning streak in a month.
Pressure in the bond market eased, at least temporarily, although investors continued to monitor the political situation in Spain and France.
Oil prices also edged lower amid signs of resilience in Middle Eastern crude exports.
At the sector level, healthcare stocks led the gains, while oil and gas shares underperformed.
Novartis (1.6%), AstraZeneca (2%), Novo Nordisk (0.8%) and Sanofi (1.8%) were higher.
The banking sector also booked solid gains, including Banco Santander (1.2%), BBVA (1.5%), UniCredit (1.9%) and UBS (1.3%).
In contrast, Schneider Electric (-2%), Repsol (-1.4%) and Telecom Italia (-1.4%) were among the worst performers.

title: European Stocks Rise for 3rd Day
